gradingSpecJson.responseIncorrect: There is a better line in this node.
gradingSpecJson.followUpContent: Combo draw: 15 outs, ~48% equity. Call 15k into 18.5k pot → need ~31%. Equity beats the price—call is +EV. You're still a slight underdog to hit by river; when the math works, calling is correct. Core lesson: Combo draws (flush + straight) have enough equity to call all-in when the price is right. Know your outs, do the pot-odds math, and call when your equity exceeds what you need—no guessing.
